questions.q: In the Mustafabad SIR row, what did most of the named booth-level agents deny?
options: Filing the Form 7 deletion applications against their names
questions.explanation: 16 of the 20 BJP-named BLAs denied filing or signing the 787 Form 7 applications credited to them.
questions.fact_text: In Delhi's **Mustafabad** constituency, **16 of 20** BJP-appointed booth-level agents (BLAs) denied filing the **787** Form 7 deletion applications (of **1,021** total) that listed them as 'objectors'; all target Muslim electors.

questions.q: Which form has the ECI been insisting that pre-existing (SIR-purged) Delhi voters file to get re-included?
questions.explanation: Despite the SC calling this an 'error', the ECI kept requiring Form 6, meant for fresh registrations.
questions.fact_text: SC assured excluded Delhi voters they won't face prosecution, but advocate **Prashant Bhushan** said ECI still forces pre-existing voters purged in SIR to file **Form 6** (meant for new voters) instead of Form 8; matter listed **19 November**.

questions.q: Section 16 of which 2023 Act is under SC challenge for giving the CEC and ECs lifelong immunity from prosecution?
options: The CEC and Other ECs (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Term of Office) Act, 2023
The Representation of the People Act
questions.explanation: This 2023 law (which also governs CEC/EC appointment) is under challenge for Section 16's blanket immunity clause.
questions.fact_text: SC sought the Centre's response on pleas challenging **Section 16** of the **Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioners (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Term of Office) Act, 2023**, which gives the CEC/ECs lifelong immunity from prosecution even after retirement.

questions.q: The SC held that laws penalising more than two children for local-body office are outdated mainly because:
options: India's Total Fertility Rate has fallen below the replacement rate
questions.explanation: India's TFR fell from 3.02 to 1.9 against a replacement rate of 2.1, so the laws' original rationale (overpopulation) no longer holds.
questions.fact_text: SC (Justice **P.S. Narasimha**): laws penalising **more than two children** for contesting local-body elections (e.g. **Javed v. State of Haryana**, 2003) have 'lost their relevance' as India's **Total Fertility Rate fell from 3.02 to 1.9** (replacement rate is 2.1), violating **Article 21**.

also.text: The SC verdict noted India's share of persons aged **60 and above rose from 8.3% (2014) to 9.7% (2024)**, and is projected to reach nearly **15% by 2036**.

questions.q: The SC's ruling on a State's power to levy a cess on sales tax reaffirmed which earlier judgment?
options: S. Kodar v. State of Kerala (1975)
Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala
Minerva Mills v. Union of India
S.R. Bommai v. Union of India
questions.explanation: The 7-judge Bench held that a sales-tax cess stays within Entry 54 of List II, as settled in S. Kodar (1975).
questions.fact_text: A 7-judge SC Bench (CJI **Surya Kant**) held that a **cess levied as a surcharge on sales tax** stays within a State's taxing power under **Entry 54, List II**, reaffirming the 1975 ruling **S. Kodar v. State of Kerala**.

questions.q: At the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit, what size of preliminary investment commitment did India secure for its renewables sector?
questions.explanation: Union Minister Pralhad Joshi said global fund managers had committed $400 billion (preliminary figures) across green hydrogen, storage and transmission.
questions.fact_text: India secured preliminary investment commitments worth **$400 billion** across renewables (green hydrogen, energy storage, transmission), announced by Union Minister **Pralhad Joshi** at the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit and Expo.

questions.q: What does the Cabinet-approved VISTAR scheme (₹4,371 crore) aim to overhaul?
options: India's statistical ecosystem, including an economic census
questions.explanation: VISTAR — the Viksit Bharat Initiative for Statistical Transformation, Analytics and Research — runs 2026-27 to 2030-31.
questions.fact_text: Union Cabinet approved the **VISTAR** scheme (**Viksit Bharat Initiative for Statistical Transformation, Analytics and Research**) with an outlay of **₹4,371 crore** (FY2026-27 to 2030-31) to overhaul India's statistical ecosystem, in three components including an economic census.

questions.q: The ₹14,500-crore VGF scheme for energy storage targets how much new grid-scale storage capacity?
questions.explanation: It funds 60 GWh of hydro pumped storage, 30 GWh of battery storage and 2 GWh of other technologies — 92 GWh in all.
questions.fact_text: Union Cabinet approved a **₹14,500-crore** Viability Gap Funding (VGF) scheme (2026-27 to 2030-31) for **92 GWh** of new grid-scale energy storage (60 GWh hydro pumped storage + 30 GWh battery storage + 2 GWh other), to help reach **411 GWh** of storage capacity by **2031-32**; total project investment **₹97,600 crore**.

questions.q: The Cabinet's ₹2,814-crore scheme supports domestic processing facilities for which critical minerals?
questions.explanation: The 5-year capex-support scheme targets lithium and nickel processing to cut import dependence.
questions.fact_text: Union Cabinet approved a **₹2,814-crore** capital-expenditure support scheme (5 years) for domestic **lithium and nickel** processing facilities, announced by Coal & Mines Minister **G. Kishan Reddy**.

questions.q: Why did gold prices rise 3% on 4 November?
options: India raised import duty on gold
The US dollar index slipped to a 5-week low ahead of midterm results
A new gold ETF was launched
questions.explanation: A weaker dollar (5-week low of 101.3) makes dollar-priced gold cheaper for other currencies, lifting demand.
questions.fact_text: Gold prices rose **3%** on 4 Nov as the US dollar index slipped to a **5-week low of 101.3** ahead of the US midterm results.

questions.q: On 4 November, Sensex and Nifty closed at approximately:
questions.explanation: It was the fifth straight session of gains, even as the VIX 'fear gauge' remained up 65.4% year-to-date.
questions.fact_text: On 4 Nov, Sensex gained **383 points (0.5%)** to **77,301** and Nifty rose **149 points (0.6%)** to **23,960** — a fifth straight day of gains; India's VIX ('fear gauge') is up **65.4%** year-to-date despite easing from its late-October high of 17.

questions.q: Mercedes-Benz's new electric GLC SUV, launched in India, offers a range of about:
questions.explanation: Priced from ₹78.5 lakh, with Mercedes announcing a fresh ₹200-crore investment taking its India total to ₹3,200 crore.
questions.fact_text: Mercedes-Benz announced a fresh **₹200-crore** investment in India (total **₹3,200 crore**) and launched the electric **GLC SUV** (from **₹78.5 lakh**, 711 km range); Chairman **Ola Källenius** said India will source more tech/components for Mercedes' global operations.

questions.q: The Fast-Track Special Courts scheme (extended by 5 more years) is funded from which source?
options: The Consolidated Fund of India directly
questions.explanation: The Centre's ₹2,353.15-crore share comes from the Nirbhaya Fund; 779 FTSCs (incl. 399 exclusive POCSO courts) have disposed 4,02,457 cases since 2019.
questions.fact_text: Union Cabinet extended the Centrally Sponsored Scheme for **Fast-Track Special Courts** (incl. exclusive **POCSO** courts) by **5 years (to 31 March 2031)**; outlay **₹3,788.04 crore** (Centre ₹2,353.15 cr + States ₹1,434.89 cr) from the **Nirbhaya Fund**; **779** FTSCs (incl. 399 POCSO-exclusive) have disposed **4,02,457** cases since **2019**; plan to scale up to **850** FTSCs.

questions.q: Under the Cabinet's Agnipath review, what happens to the 75% of Agniveers not retained after 4 years?
options: They are automatically made regular soldiers
They are discharged with no further option
They can serve 2 more years before being considered for regular enrolment
They are shifted to the Territorial Army
questions.explanation: Earlier, only up to 25% of a batch were retained after 4 years; the rest now get an additional 2-year engagement window with enhanced benefits.
questions.fact_text: Union Cabinet approved a **two-year additional engagement period** for Agniveers: the **75%** not retained after the initial 4-year term can now serve 2 more years (with higher pay) before being considered for regular enrolment; earlier only up to **25%** per batch were retained. Announced by CDS **Gen. N.S. Raja Subramani**.

questions.q: Delhi's AQI rose to 377 on 5 November mainly due to a doubling of which pollution source's share?
questions.explanation: Stubble-burning's contribution to Delhi's PM2.5 doubled from 8.2% to 16.28% in a single day, per the Union Ministry of Earth Sciences.
questions.fact_text: Delhi's 24-hour AQI rose to **377** ('very poor') on 5 Nov, up from **350**; stubble burning's share in Delhi's PM2.5 **doubled from 8.2% to 16.28%** between Tuesday and Wednesday, per the Union Ministry of Earth Sciences.

questions.q: On the CPCB's AQI scale, a reading of 420 would be classified as:
questions.explanation: 401-450 is the 'severe' band; 301-400 is 'very poor' and 451-500 is 'severe plus'.
questions.fact_text: The **Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM)** in NCR issued show-cause notices to Senior Superintendents of Police and Deputy Commissioners of **five Punjab districts** for not complying with its stubble-burning orders.

questions.q: The CAQM issued show-cause notices to police and district officials of five districts in which State over stubble burning?
questions.explanation: The notices went to Senior Superintendents of Police and Deputy Commissioners in five Punjab districts.
questions.fact_text: CPCB's AQI bands: **201-300 'poor'**, **301-400 'very poor'**, **401-450 'severe'**, **451-500 'severe plus'** (scale of 0-500).

questions.q: A recent Nature study found that the Amazon rainforest has become:
options: A stronger carbon sink than before
A net carbon source rather than a sink
questions.explanation: Wildfire emissions made the Amazon release 1.17 billion more tonnes of carbon than it absorbed (2010-2024 data); lead author Luciana Vanni Gatti.
questions.fact_text: A *Nature* study (airborne CO2 readings, 2010-2024, lead author **Luciana Vanni Gatti**) found the **Amazon rainforest is now a net carbon source, not a sink**: wildfires caused it to emit **1.17 billion tonnes** more carbon than it absorbed; in the El Niño year **2024**, **38%** of deforestation was fire-caused.

also.text: Amazon deforestation data (2010-24): mining area up **272%**, pasture area up **19%**, soybean plantations up **193%**; dry-season rainfall fell **17%** (1979-2018). A separate Indian study projects the country's vegetation carbon storage could nearly **double (97%)** by 2100, chiefly in Rajasthan, Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh.

questions.q: In the 2026 US midterms, Democrats flipped Republican-held Senate seats in how many States?
questions.explanation: Texas, Ohio, South Carolina, Iowa, Maine, North Carolina and Kansas — seven States — flipped to the Democrats.
questions.fact_text: In the 4 Nov US midterms, Democrats won control of both chambers: at least **237 of 435** House seats (analysts project 250+) and at least **54 of 100** Senate seats (incl. 2 independents), flipping **7** Republican-held Senate seats — **Texas, Ohio, South Carolina, Iowa, Maine, North Carolina, Kansas**.

questions.q: Who became the first Muslim ever elected to the US Senate, in the 2026 midterms?
questions.explanation: El-Sayed, an epidemiologist and Rhodes Scholar, defeated Republican Mike Rogers in Michigan.
questions.fact_text: US midterm 'firsts': **James Talarico** — first Democrat to win Texas statewide office in decades (beating AG **Ken Paxton**); **Adam Hamilton** — first Democratic Kansas senator since **1932**; **Annie Andrews** — first Democratic South Carolina senator since **1998**; **Abdul El-Sayed** (Michigan) — first Muslim elected to the US Senate.

questions.q: Gina Hinojosa became Texas's first Democratic Governor since which year, unseating Greg Abbott?
questions.explanation: Her win, alongside Talarico's Senate win, ended three decades of Republican statewide dominance in Texas.
questions.fact_text: Democrats now hold at least **28 of 50** US governorships (up from 24); **Gina Hinojosa** became Texas's first Democratic Governor since **1995**, unseating **Greg Abbott**; **Keisha Lance Bottoms** became Georgia's first Black woman Governor.

questions.q: What did President Trump concede had 'played a part' in the Republican midterm losses?
questions.explanation: Trump acknowledged the war's role while denying personal responsibility and vowing to veto Democratic bills.
questions.fact_text: President **Donald Trump** congratulated Democrats on the result, conceded the **Iran war** 'played a part' in Republican losses, but denied personal responsibility and warned he would **veto** Democratic bills.

questions.q: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said oil tankers caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz after:
questions.explanation: Four tankers reportedly caught fire after hitting mines while attempting to cross without authorisation; a US-made drone was also downed.
questions.fact_text: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said **four oil tankers** caught fire after striking naval mines while trying to cross the **Strait of Hormuz** without authorisation; two more vessels were halted and a US-made drone was shot down.

questions.q: The US Treasury's 'Operation Economic Outcast' sanctioned firms from India and which other country for allegedly aiding Iran?
questions.explanation: The campaign targets entities helping Iran sell oil to fund its war effort.
questions.fact_text: The US Treasury imposed fresh sanctions on firms in **India and Türkiye** for allegedly aiding Iran, under its **'Operation Economic Outcast'** campaign.

questions.q: Nirmala Lakshman won the Sharjah Award for Best International Non-Fiction Book for a book about which community?
questions.explanation: 'The Tamils: A Portrait of a Community' was published by Aleph Book Company in January 2025.
questions.fact_text: **Nirmala Lakshman**, Director of The Hindu Group, won the **Sharjah Award** for Best International Non-Fiction Book for *'The Tamils: A Portrait of a Community'* (Aleph Book Company, Jan 2025).

questions.q: Virat Kohli became the first ODI batter to average 50+ across all four SENA nations. Which of these is NOT a SENA nation?
questions.explanation: SENA stands for South Africa, England, New Zealand and Australia — not Sri Lanka.
questions.fact_text: **Virat Kohli** became the first player in ODI history with a batting average of **50+ across all four SENA nations**: South Africa (76.38), England (51.48), New Zealand (51.53), Australia (50.03).

questions.q: India beat New Zealand in the 1st ODI by how many wickets, taking a series lead?
options: It won by runs, not wickets
questions.explanation: India won by 5 wickets via the DLS method, with Kohli scoring 74 and Anshul Kamboj named Player of the Match.
questions.fact_text: India beat New Zealand by **5 wickets** (DLS method) in the 1st ODI in Auckland to lead the 5-match series **1-0**; **Kohli** (74, on the eve of his 38th birthday) and **Anshul Kamboj** (Player of the Match, 2/22 with 46 dot balls) starred.

questions.q: The Olympic gold medal stolen from M.M. Somaya's Bengaluru home was from which Games?
questions.explanation: It is India's last Olympic gold in men's hockey; Somaya played in 1980, 1984 and 1988 and won the Arjuna Award in 1985.
questions.fact_text: Former hockey captain **M.M. Somaya**'s **1980 Moscow Olympics gold medal** — India's last Olympic hockey gold — was stolen from his Bengaluru home, along with other medals and jewellery; Somaya played 3 Olympics (1980, 1984, 1988) and won the **Arjuna Award in 1985**.

questions.q: India will face which team in the first-ever India-Japan Asian Champions Trophy hockey final?
questions.explanation: India beat Korea 8-1 in the semifinal, while Japan beat Malaysia on a shootout.
questions.fact_text: India thrashed Korea **8-1** in the Asian Champions Trophy hockey semifinal in Mohali to reach its **6th ACT final in 7 editions**, where it will meet **Japan** (which beat Malaysia 5-3 on shootout) in the first-ever India-Japan ACT final.

questions.q: Kimi Antonelli became F1's youngest-ever World Champion. Whose record did he break?
questions.explanation: Antonelli (20y 68d) beat Vettel's record of 23y 134d, and is the first Italian F1 champion since Alberto Ascari in 1953.
questions.fact_text: **Kimi Antonelli** (Mercedes) became the **youngest Formula 1 World Champion ever** — **20 years, 68 days** — beating Sebastian Vettel's record (23y 134d) by finishing third in Mexico City; he is the first Italian F1 champion since **Alberto Ascari (1953)** and drives car No. **12**, like his idol **Ayrton Senna**.

questions.q: Rajkumari Lanchenbi Chanu became the first Indian to win a Youth Olympics medal in which sport?
questions.explanation: She won bronze in the women's Changquan combined event in Dakar.
questions.fact_text: **Rajkumari Lanchenbi Chanu** became the first Indian to win a **wushu** medal at the **Youth Olympic Games**, taking bronze in the women's Changquan combined event in Dakar.

questions.q: P.B. Abhinandh and Divyanshi Bhowmick became World No. 1 in which badminton category?
questions.explanation: Their rise followed a gold at the WTT Youth Star Contender (Doha) and a bronze at the Asian youth championships.
questions.fact_text: **P.B. Abhinandh and Divyanshi Bhowmick** became the World No. 1 pair in the under-19 mixed-doubles badminton rankings.
